title: Interruption, isolation, then stable recovery
description: Section A–B parts, the controller isolates, the section is repaired and the local reset button pressed. Supply returns and stays stable.
what_to_look_for: ISOLATED → RESTORATION PENDING (local reset) → RECOVERY CHECK with a 10 s progress bar → RESTORED → NORMAL.
Voltage returning is not treated as proof that restoration is safe: the controller decides when to reclose; the server only reports it.
The event closes; its end time is when supply returned (start of the stable window), not when the timer finished.

steps.note: Operator presses the LOCAL reset button on the controller
